titles.native: 愛天使伝説 ウェディングピーチ

description:
Specials of Wedding Peach included as a bonus on LD/DVD Box set volumes.

Omake 1 - Episode 10,526: Gomenne Yousuke no Maki. (第10,526回 ごめんねえよけけの巻) A preview of "Episode 10,527" appears at the end, however, this is just a teaser—it doesn't actually exist.
Omake 2 - Final Episode: Ai Tenshi Sentai Saigo no Tatakai. (最終回 愛天使戦隊最後の戦い) The "Wedding Baseball Tournament" preview of which is shown at the end of the final episode was also never released.
